photos.desc: The ashy wood pigeon ( Columba pulchricollis ) had been photographed during the birding field trip of GoingWild at Kedarnath Musk Deer Sanctuary in Chamoli district of Uttarakhand in India on November
Ashy wood pigeon found in Fulchoki, Nepal.
The Ashy Wood Pigeon was found in the phoolchowki hills as its natural habitat is located there. This local bird is known to be rare in its own habitat.
